the pen rows are BUILD cost, paid once per definition at module load: a pen emits the document a hand-written literal would have been, and every row above is asserted byte-equal to that literal before it is timed. The migration pen carries both models' shape hashes (a canonicalize + hash per side), which is the whole of its distance from a literal — and is work a hand-written migration document still has to get right
